svg.title: Sanzeed ID card — back
svg.desc: Monogram SM., contact lines, QR code (25×25 modules, EC level M) to https://sanzeed.com on a Paper tile. Units: 1 user unit = 1 mm. Layers: paper, artwork, guides (non-printing). Fonts: Fraunces 300, Inter Tight 600, Inter 400 (04_TYPOGRAPHY/Font_Files). Logo paths embedded from 02_LOGO_SYSTEM/SVG.
